title: Hub Module Manifest
description: Versioned, inheritable hub module declaration. governance_runtime drives lifecycle verbs; product_stack is informational only (DEC-0005).

governance_runtime.description: Adapter/runtime that implements lifecycle verbs for this module

product_stack.description: Informational product language/stack; must not drive lifecycle verbs

provides.description: Capabilities or paths this module supplies

requires.description: Module IDs or capability labels this module depends on

protected_paths.description: Repo-relative paths the module owns and template sync must not clobber
